items.title: Brand safety
clues: I keep ads away from content a brand dislikes.
Violence and hate speech are what I avoid.
Advertisers care about me when their name sits next to news.
items.why: Brand safety protects a brand from appearing next to harmful content.

items.title: Domain spoofing
clues: A low-value site claims to be a premium one.
Buyers pay premium prices to me by mistake.
items.why: Domain spoofing fakes a better site’s name to sell cheap inventory at a premium.

items.title: Invalid traffic
clues: I am visits that are not real viewers.
Bots create a lot of me.
Buyers do not want to pay for me.
items.why: Invalid traffic is activity that is not a real person genuinely seeing an ad.
